resources.string: Before you start
To use Abastevo, read and accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
The documents changed since your last acceptance. Read and accept them again to continue.
Abastevo is a community platform to look up and share fuel prices. It does not sell fuel and is not affiliated with ANP.
Prices, photos, ratings and comments you send must be real and follow the community rules and moderation.
The Privacy Policy explains which data is processed, why, and how to exercise your rights.
